styles.plain: a short, clear message in plain English
styles.reworded: a casual chat message: lowercase, abbreviations or a typo, the way people type to a helpdesk bot
styles.hinglish: Hinglish, Hindi words written in Latin script mixed with English, as many Indian employees write
styles.formal: a formal email with a greeting and sign-off

a letter confirming their work from home arrangement
